description: Rootless Packets-as-Code DSL & Rust compiler (v1.4.6) that compiles declarative .fasm code into deterministic, nanosecond-precision .pcap / .pcapng packet captures across 81 native Layer 2 through Layer 7 protocols (2,611 verified .fasm corpus scenarios). Companion to Wireshark/tshark, tcpreplay, Suricata, and Zeek.
rules: Every .fasm program must declare HOST <id> { IP <ip> [MAC <mac>] }, parameterized FLOW <id>(<params>) { ... }, and COMPILE { ... }.
Always use inline WAIT <int><ns|us|ms|s|m> on frame statements; never use standalone WAIT lines or +5ms / [+delay] prefixes.
Always use SRCPORT, DSTPORT, SEQ, ACKNUM, TTL, QINQ <outer> INNER_VLAN <inner>, and REQID; never use SPORT, DPORT, ACK_NUM, or HOP_LIMIT.
Never mix IPv4 and IPv6 endpoints in the same packet statement.
Always use // for .fasm comments (never #); never include // PROMPT:, // TOKENS:, or // INSTRUCTION: in human-facing docs.
